title: ID0391399-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S4 170003555] All outlets out of order
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  One outlet was out of order due to coap polling error. Rebooted the charger and after that all outlets out of order.
Root cause: Charger didn't perform converter grouping after reboot.
Solution:  Forced the charger to perform a converter grouping.
